messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick preflight for the AcmeCloud co-webinar next Tue 11am PT — want to lock speaker order, demo handoffs, and swag cutoffs.
aj-sales: Acme confirmed structure: 10m keynote, 20m joint demo, 15m live Q&A. Can we add a 10-seat hands-on lab after?
cameron-devex: Lab OK but need infra signups. We can use the shared sandbox but creds must be rotated. @lina-partnereng can you provision a scoped token by EOD?
lina-partnereng: Yes — will generate a read-only demo token and a short README. ETA 5pm. Also proposing a sanitized demo dataset to avoid any PII surprises.
sophie-ops: AV checklist: venue has HDMI + SDI. Plan: primary laptop + backup laptop + USB-C dongles. Schedule an AV check 60m prior. I can book the slot.
maria-partnerships: Proposed speaker order: 1) Acme keynote (10m) 2) Redwood intro (5m) 3) joint deep-dive demo (20m) 4) live Q&A (15m) 5) wrap + lab signup reminder (5m). Thoughts?
aj-sales: Works. For the joint demo we need a graceful fallback if cloud region is slow — can we pre-record a 2m backup clip?
cameron-devex: I'll record a 2m backup clip and keep it local on the backup laptop. Also will capture the API snippet for the demo: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <DEMO_TOKEN>" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
lina-partnereng: Token will be scoped to the sandbox. I'll add a README with exact endpoints and the sample prompt sets. Token name: redwood-acme-demo.
sophie-ops: Swag timeline: finalize items by Friday for standard US shipping. For co-branded stickers + a small hardware trinket vendor lead time is 7 business days.
maria-partnerships: @aj-sales how many registrants vs onsite seats? Need qty for swag kits.
aj-sales: Expect ~400 registrants, ~120 onsite. Recommend 150 swag kits (onsite + speaker & partner extras).
maria-partnerships: I'll loop in marketing to confirm qty and artwork. Sophie — shipping address and pickup window?
sophie-ops: Venue pickup: "The Loft, 480 Harbor Dr, Suite B". Pickup window Thu 9am-4pm. Use label: "Redwood x Acme — Conference Demo".
cameron-devex: We should rehearse speaker handoffs twice. Who triggers the demo start? Suggest Acme starts, Redwood does the deep-dive.
lina-partnereng: Acme engineer (Priya) will do the deep-dive. Dry run tomorrow 10am PT. Can people confirm availability?
maria-partnerships: I can do 10am. Please react with availability. :calendar:
event-bot: Reminder created: "Acme x Redwood — Dry Run" Thu 10:00 PT — invites sent.
aj-sales: Confirmed.
cameron-devex: Confirmed. I'll bring backup recording and laptop.
lina-partnereng: Confirmed.
sophie-ops: Confirmed. I'll bring dongles and label printer.
maria-partnerships: Final dry-run checklist:
- tokens + README (Lina)
- 2m backup clip (Cameron)
- AV plan + dongles (Sophie)
- swag qty + vendor confirmation (Maria -> marketing)
- slide deck + speaker bios (Aj)
Post one-line updates here when done.
aj-sales: Slide deck draft posted: https://drive.google.com/example (owner: aj-sales). Added speaker bios.
cameron-devex: Backup clip uploaded: https://drive.google.com/clip (backup-demo.mp4).
lina-partnereng: Token + README uploaded to sandbox repo.
sophie-ops: Vendor confirmed stickers + trinket. Shipping ETA Fri morning. Will update once pickup arranged.
maria-partnerships: Thanks — will archive demo playbook and attach to the event page after the session. :thumbsup:
